content: We would like to reemphasise that the conditions for the therapeutic factors are necessary but not sufficient; since our analysis focuses on the structure of conversations, being agnostic to the content. NLP, however, allows us to strengthen our approximations even further. Thus, the further extension of our work is also augmentation of our study with other language analysis metrics and their correlation with human annotation.
